title: Matching
transparency: This ranking is produced by an AI system. It proposes, you decide. Every score is broken down axis by axis, and every excluded profile carries a reason.

reverseMarketPicker.subtitle: No profile defends this need — look instead at where a profile from your pool would be defensible elsewhere. Nothing is added to this need.

relaunch.body:
Hi {{name}},

Where do things stand on your availability? Let me know if anything has changed.

Thanks,

cvStudio.title: Prepare CV — {{name}}
cvStudio.description: This document carries no other profile's data.

explain.title: Why this ranking — {{name}}
explain.subtitle: This document carries no other person's data: it can be handed to the person concerned as it is.
explain.failed: The explanation could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
explain.correspondenceHint: What this profile is worth against the role, axis by axis. An axis that could not be assessed leaves the calculation: it does not count as zero.
explain.pushableHint: A different question from the match: what decides whether this profile can be put forward to this client.
explain.pushableTerms: This score combines the match, availability, daily-rate fit, history at this client and the strength of evidence. The term-by-term breakdown is not part of this document.
explain.weightsHint: It is set per workspace. An explanation that hid its weights would explain nothing, and would become wrong the moment they change.
explain.downloadHint: The same content, in a file you can hand to the person concerned.
explain.downloadFailed: The document could not be downloaded.

shortlist.cap: Five profiles at most — beyond that it is no longer a shortlist.

position.title: Submit {{name}}
position.subtitle: Nothing is sent to the client at this point.
position.acknowledged: Points of attention do not block the submission: they are logged with your acknowledgement.

reasons.already_on_mission_at_client: already on a mission at this client

launch.ready: I compare this role to your talent pool. I tell you what fits, what is missing, and who is really available. Free, a few seconds.
launch.noSkills: This role has no skill recorded. Add at least one, otherwise I am comparing against nothing.
launch.readyWithGaps: I can run it. Still unknown, without stopping you from searching: {{missing}}.
launch.emptyPool: Your talent pool is empty. Import consultants or drop CVs.
launch.locked: The talent pool belongs to a higher plan.
launch.knowSomeone: No profile is submitted on this role yet. If you know someone, add them here — matching follows.

inverse.title: Which roles does this profile fit?
inverse.subtitle: I compare this profile to the roles still open. A role starting before they are free shows up as borderline, with its reason — not hidden.
inverse.empty: No open role to compare today.

summary_one: I compared {{total}} profiles. 1 is worth a look, {{borderline}} are borderline, {{excluded}} do not fit — and I tell you why for each of them.
summary_other: I compared {{total}} profiles. {{recommended}} are worth a look, {{borderline}} are borderline, {{excluded}} do not fit — and I tell you why for each of them.
journalTruncated: The ranking below is complete. The audit journal, however, only keeps the first 500 profiles: beyond that, the per-axis detail cannot be replayed from history.

door.saved: {{name}} is saved to your talent pool.

nextGesture.title: {{name}} is saved. Shall I compare them to the “{{need}}” role?

auto.queued: Automatic matching in progress — the result shows up here as soon as it is ready.
auto.unknown: Automatic matching: outcome unknown (timed out). Run it by hand to be sure.
auto.failed: Automatic matching did not complete. Run it by hand.
auto.capped: Automatic matching not run: the workspace’s daily cap is reached. Run it by hand.
auto.noCriteria: Automatic matching not run: this need had no skill when it arrived.

pick.need: Pick a need to see its profiles.
pick.consultant: Pick a profile to see where to place it.

direction.noPicker: Run the ranking first to pick one.

gesture.saved: Need updated — rerun the matching to see the effect.
gesture.saveError: The need could not be updated.
gesture.needUnavailable: This need cannot be found here: nothing is changed.
gesture.proposedBy: Suggested by client feedback ({{axis}}) — nothing changes until you confirm.

fields.noRequiredSkill: No required skill on this need.

contract.regie: Time and materials — employees and freelancers

clarifier.description: Clarify with the client what is still vague: seniority, start, duration.

negocier.description: Relax a criterion: the target rate, or a required skill that becomes optional.

elargir.description: Widen the accepted area and the possible remote work.

elargir_contrat.description: A recruitment need only accepts employees; time and materials or fixed price also opens it to freelancers.

reactiver.description: Archived profiles or profiles declared unavailable. They are reactivated from their own page.
reactiver.empty: No archived or unavailable profile in the pool.
